name: Monday Sales CRM
description: Monday Sales CRM, now branded monday CRM, is monday.com's revenue platform for managing leads, contacts, accounts, deals, customer relationships, communications, sales pipelines, forecasts, and post-sale work. It combines customizable monday boards with CRM-specific email, activity, reporting, automation, enrichment, quote, invoice, and campaign workflows.
agentUseSummary: Do not create a separate Monday Sales CRM connection or install. Connect the canonical Monday.com provider once, then use its bounded board, item, and update tools for explicitly selected CRM boards under the existing Safe or Dangerously skip permissions policy. Relay does not expose semantic lead, contact, account, deal, email, activity, campaign, enrichment, quote, invoice, forecast, or CRM-administration actions through this alias.

blocked.label: Create a separate Sales CRM connection
blocked.description: Monday Sales CRM uses the same monday user, account, OAuth grant, scopes, workspaces, boards, items, and updates as the canonical Monday.com provider; a second connection would duplicate identity and authority.

blocked.label: Install duplicate CRM tools
blocked.description: Relay mounts supported monday board, item, and update operations once through the canonical Monday.com provider rather than publishing parallel CRM tools, policies, and audit state.

blocked.label: Run separate Sales CRM actions
blocked.description: Supported bounded operations on explicitly selected CRM boards belong to the canonical Monday.com connection and its existing Safe or Dangerously skip permissions profile.

blocked.label: Operate specialized CRM records
blocked.description: Semantic lead, contact, account, company, deal, pipeline, product, quote, invoice, activity, and customer-lifecycle actions are outside Relay's current generic typed monday board and item contract.

blocked.label: Communicate or run CRM intelligence
blocked.description: Email and calendar synchronization, Emails & Activities, mass email, sequences, campaigns, call and meeting capture, enrichment, duplicate merging, lead scoring, forecasting, reporting, dashboards, AI agents, automations, imports, and exports are blocked.

blocked.label: Administer monday CRM or use raw interfaces
blocked.description: Workspace, board, schema, user, team, permission, plan, billing, app, and CRM administration, destructive or bulk changes, webhooks, raw GraphQL, platform MCP, browser sessions, scraping, and private endpoints are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Use Monday.com
approvalProfiles.description: No separate Sales CRM action is enabled because monday CRM shares the canonical Monday.com provider and only its bounded board, item, and update boundary is currently supported.

runtimeSupport.description: No duplicate Monday Sales CRM tools are mounted. OpenClaw uses the canonical Monday.com provider for approved bounded operations on explicit CRM boards and items.
No duplicate Monday Sales CRM tools are mounted. Hermes uses the canonical Monday.com provider for approved bounded operations on explicit CRM boards and items.

providerSetup.blocker: Monday Sales CRM is the earlier name for monday CRM, a specialized product built on the shared monday platform rather than a separate provider identity or authorization surface. Monday documents that its platform GraphQL API supports sales CRM and that CRM leads are items on boards, while the same app OAuth grant controls account, workspace, board, and update access. Relay's canonical Monday.com provider already owns that OAuth lifecycle, account binding, typed connector, policies, runtime mounts, audit, and bounded board and item behavior. It does not implement CRM-specific record semantics, communications, enrichment, campaigns, forecasting, or revenue administration, so a duplicate card would both repeat authority and overstate support.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep this renamed product-mode slug non-installable and direct setup, connection, installation, and supported execution to the canonical Monday.com provider. Use only its explicit bounded board listing, board-item listing, item read, update read, local draft, approval-governed item create or update, and update-posting actions on customer-selected CRM boards. Extend the canonical provider only after Relay separately specifies, implements, and accepts typed CRM resources and communications with exact scopes, account and workspace binding, record relationships, bounds, approvals, idempotency, privacy controls, audit, redaction, provider limits, and production verification.
